title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Coal India sells ₹8,981 crore of its biggest coal arm, and MCL gets none of it
short: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: ₹8,981 crore, all of it an OFS
dek: Coal India is selling 10% of its largest subsidiary at ₹129–₹136 a share. The company gets nothing; buyers get a big, profitable, high-dividend miner whose profits have been slipping.
card: MCL digs 28% of Coal India's coal and pays out most of its profit as dividends. What the ₹8,981 crore IPO offers, and what it doesn't.
hero_src: Data: MCL offer documents via Chittorgarh, PSU Watch, Upstox, Moneycontrol; splits: FIN2DAY calculation
